data.narrative: Successfully finalized Module 10 (CI/CD & Deployment). Implemented custom liveness and readiness check endpoints, configured database connection timeouts to prevent locks/hangs, verified Docker container packaging, and adjusted Railway deploy configurations to target the readiness endpoint for zero-downtime rolling deploys.

Demonstrated structured debugging by executing negative testing against the /ready probe with non-responsive Redis configurations to verify quick timeouts.
